Subject: Draft Mutual Action Plan — kickoff & stakeholder confirmation (timeline options)

Hi Erin —

Great to meet you and the team today. Per our discovery call, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) I pulled together based on the requirements you outlined (security & data partitioning, PII handling, latency targets for inference). This is a starter worksheet — we expect to iterate.

Key asks from our side:
- Please confirm the internal stakeholders who will own each milestone column (Product, Security, IT/Network, Procurement).
- Pick your preferred target close window: Option A = 8–10 weeks (aggressive, requires prioritized approvals), Option B = 12–14 weeks (standard), Option C = 20+ weeks (pilot-first cadence).
- Flag any hard dependencies (e.g., on-prem KMS rollout, SOC 2 evidence, VPN peering windows) and any blackout dates in March/April.

I attached Novus_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx with milestones, owners (proposed), and a dependency column. I also included a short SOC2 evidence checklist as a PDF the Security team requested.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm owners and pick a target close option by end of week (Mar 5).
2) We schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff to agree SLAs and handoffs (I can do Wed/Thu morning PT).
3) Karthik (on copy) will produce a milestoned rollout with resource estimates once we have confirmed owner commitments.

If helpful, I can convert the MAP to a shared Google Sheet and set ownership assignments so edits are tracked.

Thanks again for the thoughtful discussion today — excited to partner.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
